original.question: Billie ke rectangular sone kamra ka area 360 varg futi hai. Agar kamre ki lambai 3 yard hai, to kamre ka paridhi futi mein kya hoga?
original.answer:
Kamre ki lambai 3 yard * (3 futi / 1 yard) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 futi hai.
Kamre ki chaudai 360 varg futi / 9 futi = <<360/9=40>>40 futi hai.
Kamre ka paridhi 2(40+9) = 98 futi hai
